name: @rask/flow
//: The estate's Svelte Flow layer — the @rask/dockview of @xyflow/svelte, and the same shape: this package is the BINDING (viewer shell, SSR renderer, auto-fit, the layered placer, the --xy-* theme), and the domain graphs stay with their domains. LineageGraph is a lineage PANEL and lives in the lakehouse zone with its panels; the FGA builders are lakehouse access logic; the workflow EDITOR (media FlowPane, drag-to-connect) is media's. Folding any of them in here would make 'the flow package' secretly be a domain package with a generic name — the monolith shape this estate keeps rejecting. JIT like @rask/api: raw TS/Svelte, no build step. Nothing here may import `$lib/*` or `$app/*`, an API client, or any domain type: if a value is zone- or domain-shaped it arrives as a prop.
